questions.stem: What type of decimal expansion do irrational numbers have?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Non-terminating non-recurring' because irrational numbers have decimal expansions that neither terminate nor repeat. The other options are incorrect because terminating and non-terminating recurring decimals are types of rational numbers, and repeating decimals are also rational.

questions.stem: If a rational number has a decimal expansion that is non-terminating and recurring, what can be said about its prime factors?
choices: They include numbers other than 2 and 5
questions.solution: A rational number with a non-terminating and recurring decimal expansion must have prime factors other than just 2 and 5, because only numbers with prime factors limited to 2 and 5 result in terminating decimals. Options stating only 2 and 5 or only 3 and 7 are incorrect because they do not align with the properties of decimal expansions. The option that they are not defined is also incorrect because all rational numbers have defined prime factors.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the decimal expansion of 1/3?
questions.solution: The decimal expansion of 1/3 is non-terminating and recurring because dividing 1 by 3 results in 0.333..., which repeats indefinitely. A terminating decimal ends after a finite number of digits, which is not the case here. A non-terminating and non-recurring decimal would be irrational, but 1/3 is a rational number. The decimal is clearly defined and follows the pattern of a repeating decimal.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about the product of two irrational numbers?
choices: It can be either rational or irrational
questions.solution: The product of two irrational numbers can be either rational or irrational. For example, √2 × √2 equals 2, which is rational, while √2 × √3 equals √6, which is irrational. Therefore, it is not always rational or always irrational. The statement that it is always zero is incorrect because the product of two irrational numbers is not necessarily zero.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a surd?
questions.solution: The correct answer is √2 because it is an irrational number, meaning it cannot be expressed as a simple fraction. The other options, √4, √9, and √25, are all rational numbers since their square roots are integers. A surd is defined as an irrational root, so only √2 qualifies.

questions.stem: What is the absolute value of -3?

questions.stem: If the product of two surds is a rational number, what is one of them called?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Rationalizing factor.' A rationalizing factor is a surd that, when multiplied by another surd, results in a rational number. The other options are incorrect because a rational number is not a surd, an irrational number is not a specific term for this relationship, and 'factor' is too general to describe this specific mathematical concept.

questions.stem: If the decimal expansion of a number is non-terminating and non-recurring, what can be said about the number?
questions.solution: A number with a non-terminating and non-recurring decimal expansion cannot be expressed as a fraction of two integers, which defines an irrational number. Rational numbers have either terminating or repeating decimals, so the other options are incorrect. Whole and natural numbers are subsets of rational numbers and cannot have non-repeating, non-terminating decimals.

hi.stem: यदि किसी संख्या का दशमलव प्रसार असांत एवं अनियमित है, तो उस संख्या के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है?
hi.solution: एक ऐसी संख्या जिसका दशमलव प्रसार असांत एवं अनियमित है, दो पूर्ण संख्याओं के अनुपात के रूप में व्यक्त नहीं की जा सकती है, जो अपरिमेय संख्या की परिभाषा है। परिमेय संख्याओं का दशमलव प्रसार या तो सांत होता है या आवर्ती होता है, अतः अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं। पूर्ण एवं प्राकृत संख्याएं परिमेय संख्याओं के उपसमुच्चय हैं एवं असांत एवं अनियमित दशमलव नहीं हो सकते।

mr.solution: असामायिक आणि अनुक्रमणिका नसलेला दशांश विस्तार असलेली संख्या दोन पूर्णांकांच्या अंशात व्यक्त करता येत नाही, जे अपरिमेय संख्याचे निर्वचन आहे. परिमेय संख्यांचा दशांश विस्तार अंतिम असतो किंवा पुनरावृत्ती असतो, म्हणून इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत. पूर्ण आणि प्राकृतिक संख्या परिमेय संख्यांच्या उपसमुच्चय आहेत आणि असामायिक, अनुक्रमणिका नसलेला दशांश विस्तार असू शकत नाहीत.
